description: This file contains implementation details for CUDA Jiterator, including utility functions, template classes, and variant structures for offset calculation and memory access, conditioned on the AT_USE_JITERATOR macro.

classes.name: OffsetCalculatorVariant
classes.description: A variant wrapper for different OffsetCalculator types based on tensor input/output count.

classes.name: ArrayVariant
classes.description: A variant wrapper for arrays of pointers for up to 8 inputs and outputs.

classes.name: TrivialOffsetCalculatorVariant
classes.description: A variant wrapper for TrivialOffsetCalculator types based on number of tensors.

classes.name: LoadWithCastVariant
classes.description: A variant wrapper for LoadWithCast objects for different tensor counts.

classes.name: StoreWithCastVariant
classes.description: A variant wrapper for StoreWithCast objects for different tensor counts.

methods.name: get_extra_args_typenames
methods.description: Returns a vector of type names for extra scalar arguments.

methods.name: can_vectorize_up_to
methods.description: Determines the maximum vectorization size for a given scalar type and pointer.

methods.name: jitted_can_vectorize_up_to
methods.description: JIT version that determines vectorization size for a TensorIterator.

methods.name: make_unique_offset_calculator
methods.description: Creates a unique pointer to an OffsetCalculator based on tensor iterator properties.
